scan_linter_check.description:
Flags new GlideRecord(...) and new GlideAggregate(...) in Script Includes with "Client callable" set. These classes do not enforce ACLs, and a client-callable Script Include can be called from any browser session (GlideAjax), so a caller may read or change data they are not allowed to. A GlideRecord whose code calls canRead(), canWrite(), canCreate() or canDelete() on the same variable is not reported: access is checked explicitly.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Use GlideRecordSecure for Client Callable Script Includes".
scan_linter_check.name: SEC-003: Client-callable Script Include queries without ACLs
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Use GlideRecordSecure in client-callable Script Includes so ACLs are enforced for the calling user. If GlideRecord is required, check access explicitly (canRead/canWrite) before returning or changing data, and validate every sysparm parameter.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A client-callable Script Include uses GlideRecord/GlideAggregate (no ACLs).
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SEC-003: Client-callable Script Include queries without ACLs
